Great Dog Rescue New England (GDRNE), a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, would like you to meet Nola, a young local pup who is ready to find her forever home. This sweet southern belle was discovered living as a stray in Mississippi along with a litter of puppies.
